description: Text recognition for scans, photos of documents, screenshots and scanned PDFs: the text in reading order, each line with its page, position and confidence. English and other Latin-script text; small or soft images are enlarged first. Price: $0.03 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Document tools: Work with PDFs and scans: read the text out of a PDF with page numbers and metadata, recognize the text in a scan, photo or screenshot, merge PDFs, take or reorder pages, split into parts, and turn images into a PDF..

image.description: Image as base64: a scan, a photo of a document, a screenshot (PNG, JPEG, WebP, TIFF).

layout.description: auto finds columns and paragraphs; single-block for one plain block of text; single-line for a label or a number; sparse for text scattered over a picture (UI, signs).

minConfidence.description: Drop lines the engine is less sure of than this (0 to 100).

pages.description: For a PDF: pages to read, like "1-3". The first 10 when omitted; up to 15 per call.

pdf.description: Or a scanned PDF as base64: its pages are drawn and read one by one.

name: doc_tools_ocr
